claims.paraphrase: Geometry perturbation and steady RANS CFD produce engineering-field data. The learned surface-field benchmark is a separate surrogate task, not a learned physical data generator.

The author pipeline uses approximately12million cells, SST k-omega, moving ground, rotating wheels, porous engine,40m/s inlet and prescribed turbulence/residual conditions. Supplementary equations, parameter tables and mesh convergence sections are referenced but not embedded.

Three25percent-scale rear-configuration baselines are compared to wind-tunnel data. Table2 drag deviations are1.12,0.82,1.17percent;1.04percent is reported as their average. Sixty pressure taps and PIV/wake comparisons have a different measurement scope.

Abstract below1.04percent phrasing must not become a maximum error over12000cases. Learned-vs-CFD drag errors2.99/2.78percent at400/1200examples differ from wind-tunnel agreement. Section2 pressure wording and Table1 precision need distinct evidence records.

150cases/config wording,80/20 train/test wording and a12000training-size row require exact membership reconciliation. Mean/std over dataset samples need a train-only-fit audit before independent-generalization inference; realized leakage is not established.

The dataset declares CC BY-NC-SA4.0 while conclusions use permissive wording. STAR-CCM+ and the educational-license acknowledgment establish a proprietary solver dependency. Large CPU/mesh/storage costs do not establish minimal pretrained inference cost.

The caption describes scaling/improvement whereas the table body contains wind-tunnel drag and simulation deviations. Preserve this source inconsistency as a provenance question; do not reinterpret the numbers as training scaling.

Author checklist answers and industrial-grade claims do not establish a clean-start run, verified asset licenses or manufacturing-site qualification. Referenced external appendices remain separate unread documents.
